Rationally designed functionally graded porous Ti6Al4V scaffolds with high strength and toughness built via selective laser melting for load-bearing orthopedic applications.

High AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Read now mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Yin-Ze Xiong, Rui-Ning Gao, Hang Zhang, Lan-Lan Dong, Jian-Tao Li et al. Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials 2020-04-01 10.1016/j.jmbbm.2020.103673
单位: School of Mechanical Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, State Key Laboratory of Mechanical System and Vibration, Shanghai, 200240, China.
通讯: Xiang Li @ School of Mechanical Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, State Key Laboratory of Mechanical System and Vibration
相关性: 该研究通过SLM制备功能梯度多孔Ti6Al4V支架，系统评估了其力学性能与骨匹配性，直接服务于用户关于增材制造生物医用金属材料的研究方向。
边界: The paper does not include fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or in vitro osseointegration experiments.
动机· 开发模仿骨梯度孔隙结构的SLM钛合金支架以实现力学和生物学性能协同优化。
方法· 设计四种不同结构的功能梯度支架，采用SLM制备并系统比较其物理、力学及变形行为。
结果· 蜂窝型单元与外层支撑结构组合的支架具有最高屈服强度、韧性和稳定力学性能，弹性模量与皮质骨匹配。
验证· 通过压缩力学测试比较不同结构性能。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To develop SLM-produced Ti6Al4V scaffolds with functionally graded porosity mimicking natural bone for improved mechanical and biological performance in load-bearing orthopedic implants.
Method· Four functionally graded scaffold designs combining diamond and honeycomb unit cells with solid supports were fabricated via selective laser melting and systematically characterized.
Result· Honeycomb-based scaffolds with outer-layer supports achieved the highest yield strength and toughness, with Young's moduli matching cortical bone (~3.79–10.99 GPa).
Validation· Static compression tests were performed to evaluate mechanical properties, deformation behaviors, and compare with bone properties.

A novel kriging based active learning method for structural reliability analysis

High FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark UQ
Linxiong Hong, Huacong Li, Kai Peng, Hongliang Xiao Journal of Mechanical Science and Technology 2020-04-01 10.1007/s12206-020-0317-y
单位: School of Power and Energy, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi’an, 710072, China
通讯: Linxiong Hong @ School of Power and Energy, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi’an, 710072, China
相关性: 该论文提出的基于克里金法的主动学习方法可用于结构可靠性分析，其框架可迁移至植入物力学性能的代理建模与不确定性量化。
边界: This paper focuses on structural reliability analysis with no direct application to biomedical implants or biomechanics FEA.
动机· 提高结构可靠性分析中昂贵仿真的采样效率
方法· 提出一种基于克里金模型的主动学习策略，自适应选择最优点
结果· 在多个数值算例中显著减少了所需仿真次数，同时保持精度
验证· 通过四个经典结构可靠性基准问题验证方法有效性
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To improve sampling efficiency in expensive finite element simulations for structural reliability analysis.
Method· A novel active learning method based on kriging surrogate model is proposed to adaptively select the most informative training points.
Result· The method significantly reduces the number of required simulations while maintaining high accuracy across multiple benchmark problems.
Validation· Validation is performed on four classical structural reliability benchmark problems.

单位: College of Stomatology, Chongqing Medical University, Chongqing 401147, China.
通讯: He Zhang @ Stomatological Hospital of Chongqing Medical University, Chongqing 401147, China. Electronic address: kqzhanghe@hospital  |  Sheng Yang @ Stomatological Hospital of Chongqing Medical University, Chongqing 401147, China; Chongqing Key Laboratory of Oral Disea
相关性: 论文涉及LPBF制造的多孔钛支架和骨整合评估，但缺乏机械测试和疲劳分析，可能与力学性能匹配方向部分相关。
边界: This paper does not include any mechanical testing (static or fatigue) to evaluate stress shielding or stiffness matching, nor does it report as-built surface roughness or morphology.
动机· 钛支架骨整合慢，需加速。
方法· 3D打印多孔钛支架阳极氧化制备TiO2纳米管并负载VD3。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To accelerate osseointegration of titanium scaffolds by mimicking trabecular bone structure and local drug delivery.
Method· Hierarchical porous titanium scaffolds were fabricated via selective laser melting, anodized to form TiO2 nanotubes, and loaded with 1α,25-Dihydroxyvitamin D3.
Result· The drug-loaded hierarchical scaffolds significantly enhanced osteogenesis and early osseointegration in vitro and in vivo.
Validation· In vitro cell assays and in vivo rat animal model.

A mechanical property evaluation of Ti6Al4V cellular lattice structures fabricated by selective laser melting

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Direct Skim only mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Mohd Zaidi Azir, Wan Sharuzi Wan Harun, K. Kadirgama IOP Conference Series Materials Science and Engineering 2020-04-01 10.1088/1757-899x/788/1/012010
单位: Faculty of Engineering Technology, DRB Hicom University of Automotive Malaysia, 26600 Pekan, Pahang, Malaysia
通讯: Mohd Zaidi Azir @ Faculty of Engineering Technology, DRB Hicom University of Automotive Malaysia, 26600 Pekan, Pahang, Malaysia
相关性: 该论文研究了Ti6Al4V点阵结构的力学性能，与用户关注的AM生物医学植入物方向相关，但缺乏疲劳测试和表面形貌分析。
边界: This paper does not cover fatigue testing, surface roughness, as-built morphology, or osseointegration, and does not explicitly link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching for biomedical implants.
动机· 研究SLM制备的Ti6Al4V点阵结构的力学性能，探索结构参数对弹性模量和抗压强度的影响。
方法· 设计不同支柱尺寸、形状、单元尺寸和孔隙率的点阵结构，通过压缩试验测试力学性能。
结果· 点阵结构的弹性模量在0.01-1.84 GPa之间，孔隙率对弹性模量和抗压强度影响显著。
验证· 通过压缩试验进行力学性能表征，对比不同设计参数下的结果。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· This study investigates the mechanical properties of Ti6Al4V cellular lattice structures fabricated by selective laser melting, aiming to understand the influence of design parameters on Young's modulus and compressive strength.
Method· Lattice structures with varying strut size, strut shape, unit cell size, and porosity were designed and fabricated via SLM, followed by compression testing.
Result· The Young's modulus of the fabricated structures ranged from 0.01 to 1.84 GPa, with porosity playing a dominant role in determining both modulus and compressive strength.
Validation· Mechanical properties were validated through compression tests, and the effects of design parameters were compared graphically.

边界: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization.
动机· 神经外科电极植入时弯曲预测缺乏不确定性量化。
方法· 使用MC Dropout神经网络，基于图像特征回归电极局部位移并量化不确定性。

Motivation· To quantify prediction uncertainty in electrode bending during stereotactic neurosurgery for safer surgical planning.
Method· Monte Carlo dropout is applied to a neural network that regresses local electrode displacement from image features, with 200 stochastic forward passes.
Result· The stochastic model outperforms a deterministic baseline and provides confidence intervals along the predicted electrode trajectory.
Validation· 10-fold cross-validation comparing the stochastic model against a non-dropout baseline.

Structural Reliability Algorithms of Kriging Model Based on Improved Learning Strategy

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark UQ
Linxiong Hong, Huacong Li, Kai Peng, Hongliang Xiao Xibei Gongye Daxue Xuebao/Journal of Northwestern Polytechnical University 2020-04-01 10.1051/jnwpu/20203820412
单位: School of Power and Energy, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi'an 710072, China
通讯: Linxiong Hong @ School of Power and Energy, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi'an 710072, China
相关性: 该论文提出的改进EGO主动学习策略可提高Kriging模型在可靠性分析中的采样效率，适用于解决生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真问题。
边界: This paper focuses on structural reliability analysis with Kriging surrogate, but does not address multi-objective optimization, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification beyond failure probability estimation, and lacks biomedical or implant-specific context.
动机· 解决机械产品可靠性分析中隐式、高度非线性极限状态函数的计算效率问题。
方法· 提出改进EGO主动学习策略，通过处理预测绝对值并保持响应分布，将选点重点移至预测方差大或靠近极限状态面的区域。
结果· 相比经典方法，改进方法具有更好的全局和局部搜索能力，能以较少极限状态函数计算量精确估计失效概率。
验证· 通过三个数值算例验证，与经典主动学习方法对比。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To address the computational inefficiency of reliability analysis for mechanical structures with implicit and highly nonlinear limit state functions.
Method· An improved EGO active learning strategy is proposed that shifts the selection focus to regions with high prediction variance or near the limit state surface by processing absolute predicted values while preserving the response distribution.
Result· The proposed method demonstrates superior global and local search capabilities compared to classical active learning methods, enabling accurate failure probability estimation with fewer limit state function evaluations.
Validation· Validation is performed on three numerical benchmark examples with comparison to classical active learning methods.

动机· 传统细胞培养难以模拟肌肉组织的收缩功能，需要更真实的体外模型。
方法· 使用3D生物打印技术构建含RGD-海藻酸盐、胶原和纤维蛋白原的骨骼肌环模型。
结果· 优化后的配方形成多核肌管，肌球蛋白重链1上调30倍，模型稳定存活超过10天。
验证· 通过活细胞成像、免疫荧光和qPCR验证肌管形成和基因表达。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Traditional cell culture fails to recapitulate muscle contraction and tissue-level function, motivating a 3D bioprinted model.
Method· C2C12 myoblasts were bioprinted as rings using a bioink of RGD-alginate, collagen-I, and fibrinogen, with an acellular frame for auxotonic loading.
Result· Optimized bioink (0.25% alginate, 1 mg/mL collagen, 20 mg/mL fibrinogen) and aprotinin yielded stable, contractile myotubes with 30-fold upregulation of myosin heavy chain 1.
Validation· Validation included live-cell microscopy, f-actin immunofluorescence, and qPCR for contraction-related genes.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To improve the poor adhesion of anodic TiO2 nanotube arrays on titanium substrates for biomedical applications.
Method· Grain refinement of the titanium substrate via high-pressure torsion processing to enhance interfacial mechanical anchorage.
Result· Shorter nanotubes exhibited higher adhesion strength, while post-anodization annealing reduced adhesion; grain refinement improved biocompatibility and osseointegration.
Validation· Adhesion strength was quantified mechanically, and biocompatibility was assessed through in vitro osseointegration tests.

Motivation· To address the lack of in-situ characterization of electrochemical behavior within porous titanium alloy structures for biomedical applications.
Method· A specialized simulation device was employed to monitor ion concentration and surface potential gradients across pore depths during immersion in phosphate buffered saline.
Result· Cellular Ti-6Al-4V exhibited passivation rather than corrosion after 14 days, with thinner passive films and higher donor densities at deeper pore depths.
Validation· X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy and Mott-Schottky analysis confirmed passive film composition and electronic properties.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To address the lack of collaborative optimization of density and surface roughness in selective laser melting (SLM).
Method· Response surface methodology was used to model the effects of laser power, scanning speed, and hatch spacing on density and surface roughness, followed by multi-objective optimization.
Result· Laser power and scanning speed significantly affect both quality metrics, while hatch spacing has a minor influence; optimized parameters yield parts with high relative density and low surface roughness.
Validation· Experimental validation was performed by fabricating 316L stainless steel parts under optimized parameters and measuring density and surface roughness.

Kathryn M.S. Johnson, Margaret E. Stieben, Sue Wick The FASEB Journal 2020-04-01 10.1096/fasebj.2020.34.s1.06448
单位: Trail Build LLC
通讯: Kathryn M.S. Johnson @ Trail Build LLC
相关性: 该论文讨论的是生物学教育中的主动学习策略，与有限元代理建模或生物力学设计无关。

动机· 支持生物学教师实施基于证据的主动学习策略。
方法· 通过PALM网络提供一对一导师指导和社区支持。

Motivation· To support biology educators in implementing evidence-based active learning strategies through a structured mentoring network.
Method· The PALM Network pairs faculty/postdocs with experienced mentors for year-long support, including site visits and virtual meetings.
Result· Fellows' self-reported confidence in backward design and assessment improved to match mentors' levels after one year.
Validation· Mixed-methods assessment using online surveys and grounded-theory analysis of semi-structured interviews.

动机· 评估翻转课堂在解剖学课程中对学生成绩的影响
方法· 比较2018年传统授课与2019年翻转课堂两个学生队列的考试成绩

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the effect of a flipped classroom approach on student performance in a gross anatomy course.
Method· Retrospective comparison of exam scores between two consecutive cohorts: one receiving traditional lectures (2018) and one using pre-recorded videos with in-class activities (2019).
Result· Students in the flipped classroom scored significantly higher on practical exams but not on written exams.
Validation· Retrospective study with two cohorts of 30 students each, using t-tests to compare exam scores.

动机· 探讨如何通过自我评估培养学生的内在学习动机。

Result· Average exam scores improved by 14% compared to control groups, and students spontaneously adopted self-assessment in later course sections.
Validation· Comparison of exam performance and subsequent study behaviors across cohorts with different guidance conditions.

Validation· Analysis of Likert-scale questionnaire responses from medical students.

Dave Garg, Jane Rhyu, Shalini Bhat Journal of the Endocrine Society 2020-04-01 10.1210/jendso/bvaa046.530
单位: UCLA, Los Angeles, CA, USA
通讯: Dave Garg @ UCLA, Los Angeles, CA, USA
相关性: 该论文为临床病例报告，未涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物分析。
边界: This paper is a clinical case report on brown tumor pathology, with no biomechanical modeling, implant design, FEA, or stress shielding analysis.
动机· 报告一例罕见的FDG阴性棕色瘤病例
方法· 病例描述与文献回顾
结果· 发现棕色瘤可无FDG摄取，提示葡萄糖代谢不反映破骨活性
验证· 无验证，仅病例报告
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To report a rare case of FDG-avid negative brown tumor in the left femur associated with secondary hyperparathyroidism.
Method· Clinical case description and literature review.
Result· The brown tumor showed no FDG uptake, suggesting glucose utilization does not necessarily reflect osteoclastic activity.
Validation· No validation; single case report.

Aluminium Nanoparticles Released by Joint Implants ‐ Quartz Crystal Microbalance with Dissipation Analysis

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore in_vitro Exp. validation
Jakub R. Pękala, Przemysław A. Pękala, Iwona M. Tomaszewska, Maria José Santos-Martínez, Marek Radomski et al. The FASEB Journal 2020-04-01 10.1096/fasebj.2020.34.s1.06011
单位: Jagiellonian University Medical College, The International Evidence-Based Anatomy Working Group
通讯: Jakub R. Pękala @ Jagiellonian University Medical College, The International Evidence-Based Anatomy Working Group
相关性: 该论文研究关节假体释放的铝纳米颗粒对血小板的影响，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡、微动或生物力学建模。
边界: This paper focuses on nanoparticle toxicity and platelet activation, with no quantification of stress shielding, micromotion, or any biomechanical analysis of hip implants.
动机· 评估关节假体释放的铝纳米颗粒对血小板的影响
方法· 使用QCM-D、流式细胞术和聚集度测定法检测不同尺寸Al2O3纳米颗粒对血小板的激活和聚集
结果· 小尺寸颗粒诱导血小板聚集，大尺寸颗粒穿透血小板并释放钙离子
验证· 光学显微镜和透射电镜验证血小板聚集和颗粒穿透
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To assess the effect of aluminum nanoparticles released from joint prostheses on thrombocyte function in vitro.
Method· Quartz crystal microbalance with dissipation (QCM-D), flow cytometry, and light transmission aggregometry were used to evaluate platelet activation and aggregation induced by Al2O3 nanoparticles of varying sizes.
Result· Smaller nanoparticles induced platelet aggregation, while larger nanoparticles penetrated platelets and caused calcium release without aggregation.
Validation· Optical microscopy and transmission electron microscopy confirmed platelet aggregation and nanoparticle penetration.

OUTCOMES OF CORE DECOMPRESSION WITH INJECTION OF BONE MARROW ASPIRATE FOR PEDIATRIC FEMORAL HEAD OSTEONECROSIS

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore clinical
Myles Atkins, Josny Thimothee, Tyler C. McDonald, Patrick B. Wright, Jaysson T. Brooks Orthopaedic Journal of Sports Medicine 2020-04-01 10.1177/2325967120s00285
单位: Morehouse School of Medicine, GA, USA
通讯: Myles Atkins @ Morehouse School of Medicine, GA, USA
相关性: 该论文关注儿童股骨头坏死的临床治疗结果，未涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物设计。
边界: This paper is a clinical outcomes study of core decompression with bone marrow aspirate injection, with no biomechanical modeling, no implant design, no FEA, and no stress shielding or micromotion analysis.
动机· 评估骨髓抽吸注射联合髓芯减压术治疗儿童股骨头坏死的疗效。
方法· 回顾性分析26例儿童股骨头坏死患者的临床资料。
结果· 多数患者无需全髋置换，但未行截骨术的患者更易进展至全髋置换。
验证· 基于临床随访和Stulberg分级的回顾性研究。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the outcomes of core decompression with bone marrow aspirate injection in pediatric femoral head osteonecrosis.
Method· A retrospective chart review of 26 hips in pediatric patients undergoing core decompression with BMA injection.
Result· Most hips did not require total hip arthroplasty, but all conversions occurred in patients without concomitant osteotomies.
Validation· Clinical follow-up with Stulberg classification and THA conversion rate.
